questions.prompt: Which replication model has no single leader and uses quorums?
Which risk comes with asynchronous followers on failover?
options: Losing writes the old leader confirmed

questions.prompt: With n = 3, w = 2, r = 2, one node can be down for both reads and writes.
Last write wins resolves conflicts by what?
options: Keeping the write with the highest timestamp and discarding the others

questions.prompt: Users complain their edits vanish after saving. Which fix is most precise?
options: Track each user's write position and read only from followers that have applied it

questions.prompt: Which guarantee does sticky routing provide?
Why can an hour-stale follower still receive reads?
options: Health checks test only whether it's up, not its lag

questions.prompt: Which cache pattern acknowledges writes from the cache and flushes to the database later? (one word, hyphen allowed)
Why delete rather than update a cache entry after a write?
options: Deletes are idempotent and order-insensitive under concurrent writers

questions.prompt: A cache restart sends every key to the database at once. What's that called, and one defense?
options: A cold start; warm the cache before sending it traffic

questions.prompt: Which eviction policy resists scans best?
Causal consistency requires a consensus round trip on every write.
